Name: Turn-Based Combat
Author: GoodSmarts
Description:
[center][b][size=4]I did [i]not[/i] know about [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45879]Combatplus[/url] when I started this. If you want a more in-depth system, try that one out. This one is intended to be simpler and more based off vanilla stats, if that's more your jam.[/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=4][b]---[/b][/size][/center]
[center][b][size=6]Battle enemies with up to 4 players![/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=6]Or battle your friends...[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/i5HNq69.gif[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#ffff00][size=6]--- Next Plans ---[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][spoiler][left][size=3]In the future, I'll be adding [color=#ffff00]more battle themes [/color]for when you're battling in different areas. I already have a couple demos for Skull Cavern and the Volcano.

When there's a decent batch of songs finished for the mod, [color=#ffff00]I plan to release the music on Bandcamp[/color] to download for free. Maybe streaming, but Bandcamp for sure.[/size][/left]
[/spoiler]
[/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Features ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds a turn-based combat system, which triggers whenever you make direct contact with an enemy. You can still use weapons out of combat and fight like vanilla, but instead of getting hit, you're taken to a battle screen. Spend energy to use abilities during turn-based. Some special abilities can increase enemy item drops and Combat XP gained, so even though you can kill enemies outside of turn-based combat, you may find it beneficial to do turn-based anyway.[/color]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]I designed sound effects and made battle music for during the fights. Volumes are configurable with GMCM. You can place audio files in the custom_music folder and enable custom music in GMCM to [/color][color=#00ffff][b]add your own battle themes[/b][/color][color=#D4D4D8] to the game. The readme[/color][color=#d4d4d8].txt contains the proper file format you need.[/color][/left]
[left][center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
In battle, you have some options:
[list=1]
[*]Attack[/*]
[*]Dodge[/*]
[*]Abilities (or Trinket)[/*]
[*]Item[/*]
[*]Limit[/*]
[*]Flee[/*]
[/list]Your initial equipped weapon for the battle is whatever you had selected in your hotbar when the battle began. If it wasn't a weapon, you will attack with your fists. To equip a new weapon, choose [color=#ffffff]"[/color][b][color=#00ffff]Item[/color][/b][color=#ffffff]"[/color] and select one. The enemy gets a turn after you equip or use an item. You can pin items to the top of your item menu and move them around.[/left]
[left][center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][b][b]Currently Usable Battle Items:[/b][/b][/center]
[center][spoiler][left][color=#ffffff][b][size=4]Food/Elixirs [/size][/b][size=3]- Anything that restores health or energy can be used on you or your friends.[/size][/color][/left]
[left][color=#ffffff][b][size=4]All Bomb Types[/size][/b] - Consumable. Damages all enemies on the field for a set amount of damage.
[b][size=4]Warp Totems & Return Scepter[/size][/b] - Instantly teleport away from the battle. You don't gain any rewards.
[b][size=4]Fishing Rods[/size][/b] - Cast at an enemy for a 50% chance to snag an item from them.
[b][size=4]Squid Ink [/size][/b]- Consumable. Inks all enemies on the field, making them miss attacks for a few turns.
[b][size=4]Bone Flute[/size][/b] - Play a convincing melody for a chance to make enemies flee.
[b][size=4]Ancient Drum[/size][/b] - Drum some tunes to inspire your party, giving everyone a damage and crit-chance boost.
[b][size=4]Lucky Purple Shorts[/size][/b] - ???[/color][/left]
[/spoiler]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[b][color=#00ffff]Dodge[/color][/b] costs some energy but grants a chance to avoid enemy attacks for two turns.
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
The [color=#00ffff][b]Abilities[/b][/color] button opens a menu where you can choose from 5 different abilities unique to whatever weapon-type you're holding (Sword, Club, Dagger, Slingshot). New abilities are unlocked based on your vanilla Combat skill at levels 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. Abilities cost energy, and some abilities can add status effects to yourself or to enemies.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left]If you have a [color=#00ffff][b]trinket[/b][/color] equipped, it will appear on the left side of your Abilities button. [i]Every[/i] trinket has a unique turn-based effect, and you can use yours once per battle.
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
When you take damage, your [color=#00ffff][b]Limit[/b][/color] meter fills, à la Final Fantasy. Once it's full, you can use a Limit Break ability. You can hold onto it between battles.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left][b][color=#00ffff]Most enemies have unique actions[/color][/b] they may use during their fight. There are some pretty unique effects for some of them and a good deal of flavor text, à la Dragon Quest. They can inflict status effects on you or themselves.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][img width=581]https://i.imgur.com/6KLg2oM.gif[/img][/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left]Don't like playing the game? There's an [color=#00ffff][b]Auto-Battler[/b] [/color]button at the bottom of the battle screen. Turn it on and your character will act on their own. The settings button beneath it lets you choose your Auto-Battler combat strategy and tweak a few rules for it.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left]There's a very in-depth [color=#00ffff][b]stats menu[/b] [/color]accessible from either the battle screen or a new button on the bottom left of the vanilla Skills menu (can be disabled). In multiplayer, you can compare stats with other players in your game and share them in chat.
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
If GMCM is installed, there's also an options button on the bottom right of the battle menu. From there, you can change a LOT of things, tuning the mod to your taste. In multiplayer, the host controls gameplay-related settings. There are even some [color=#00ffff][b]cheats[/b][/color] at the very bottom.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]- [/color][/center]
[left]Sometimes you can get lucky, and a [color=#00ffff][b]golden enemy[/b][/color] will spawn in the battle. You'll miss a lot against them, and they'll probably run away, but you can gain some nice rewards and 10x combat XP for defeating them. [color=#666666](Yeah they're pretty much metal slimes.)[/color][/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left][size=2]One little note: Enemies that are meant to be invulnerable (like Mummies or Armored Bugs) can be killed if you defeat them in turn-based combat.[/size][/left]
[left][size=2]Related: If an enemy can't damage you in real-time vanilla combat (like a Mummy on the floor), they will not be able to attack you during turn-based.[/size][/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Multiplayer ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][size=3]Multiplayer is supported with [b][color=#00ffff]up to 4 players to a battle[/color][/b]. All players must have the mod installed on the same mod version. If one player doesn't have it, the mod is disabled for everyone.[/size][/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left][size=3]If players are in the same room/area, anybody triggering a battle will pull everybody into a group battle. If you have more than 4 players, the mod will randomly select 3 other players in the room to join. The battle will wait for everyone to close any menus before it starts.[/size]
[center][color=#000000][size=3]-[/size][/color][/center]
[size=3]Swing a melee weapon at another player to [b][color=#00ffff]start a 1-on-1 PvP battle[/color][/b] with them. Either player can surrender at any time. By default, all health, energy, items, etc. are restored after the battle. You can turn on "PvP consequences" to get the option to kill your friend and send them to the clinic.[/size]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][img width=376]https://i.imgur.com/732pj2x.gif[/img][/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[/left]
[center][b][size=6]--- Requirements ---[/size][/b][/center]
[center][left]The only requirement is SMAPI.[/left]
[left]While [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] isn't [i]technically[/i] required, it is [b]EXTREMELY[/b] recommended. You really should already have it.[/left]
[/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Compatibility ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][b][size=4][color=#00ff00]MULTIPLAYER IS SUPPORTED FOR ONLINE AND LAN![/color][/size][/b][/left]
[left][b][size=4][color=#00ff00]ALL PLAYERS NEED THE SAME VERSION OF THE MOD INSTALLED.[/color][/size][/b][/left]
[left][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]SPLITSCREEN IS [u]NOT[/u] SUPPORTED.[/size][/color][/b][/left]
[center][left][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]MOBILE NOT TESTED[/size][size=4] - 99.9% CHANCE SOMETHING WILL BE WRONG.[/size][/color][/b][/left]
[left][color=#ff0000][size=3]Incompatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45879]Combatplus[/url], for obvious turn-based reasons.[/size][/color][/left]
[left][size=3][color=#000000]---[/color][/size][/left]
[left][i][color=#ffff00]May have minor issues if a mod adds levels for combat skill past level 10. Untested.[/color][/i][/left]
[left][i][color=#000000]---[/color][/i][/left]
[left][color=#93c47d]*Probably compatible with modded weapons.[/color] [i][color=#666666]([/color][color=#666666]Safe if they're marked sword, dagger, club, or slingshot in the files.)[/color][/i][/left]
[left][color=#00ff00]Compatible with modded enemies.[/color] [i][color=#666666](They won't have unique abilities unless part of a vanilla monster family.)[/color][/i][/left]
[left][color=#00ff00]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23697]Mastery Extended[/url].[/color] [/left]
[left][color=#00ff00]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] outfits.[/color][/left]
[left][color=#00ff00]Compatible with controller or keyboard inputs.[/color][/left]
[left][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Safe and seamless to install or uninstall mid-playthrough. Mod is designed with this is mind.[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color]
[b][size=6]--- AI Disclosure ---[/size][/b]
[left]Very sorry to disappoint, but [color=#ffff00][b]this mod [/b][b]was heavily coded[/b][/color][b][color=#ffff00] with Claude[/color][/b]; I'll admit to it for the sake of transparency as I don't want to dupe anyone. That being said, I've done a lot of testing to make sure the mod doesn't [i]feel [/i]like AI slop, and it feels pretty good.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][b][color=#ffff00]The music and sound effects are NOT MADE WITH AI.[/color][/b] I made them all myself in FL Studio. I am a musician and a huge fan of JRPGs. I feel differently about AI writing code, but I am [i]strongly[/i] against AI music, AI images, AI videos, the like.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][b][color=#ffff00]The only AI aspect is code.[/color][/b] I designed the systems, visuals, mechanics, abilities, really everything you can see. All of the backgrounds are made by hand by me in Tiled. All of the text in the battle log and ability descriptions and the names of everything are written by myself.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Ultimately, if it's a dealbreaker for you, I understand. There are a lot of mods on Nexus that aren't properly labeled as AI, and I feel morally obligated to let people know.[/left]
[/center]

Downloads.Description:
- Battle items: Bone Flute, Ancient Drum, Squid Ink, Lucky Purple Shorts, bombs, warp totems, fishing rods
- Added rare golden enemies
- Attack damage preview
- Items menu favoriting
- Two new cheats
- Switched sound files to .ogg to reduce file size
